t: You're on Frith Street, in the heart of Soho. Soho Square is to the north and Shaftesbury Avenue to the south, and the street crosses Old Compton Street, Bateman Street and Romilly Street. Jeremiah Fitzpatrick died here in 1810. He was a physician and a campaigner for prison reform, so this busy Soho street was also the last address of someone who cared about conditions for people held in the country's prisons.
